question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 6.5 years at 4% per annum rate of interest
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = Rate × Time

⇒ Total % = 4% × 6.5 = 26%

Simple Interest = 26% of Principal

⇒ SI = 26% of 400 = 104

**∴ The correct answer is ₹104.**
